rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial intensifier or disbelief marker.

example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 ji4 gaa1 zau2

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when “seriously” means “very” or “to a great degree.”
Use this when an action is done in earnest rather than casually or jokingly.

example.jyutping: keoi5 jan6 zan1 gam2 tung4 ngo5 dou6 hip3

rows.note: Use this to signal that you are switching from joking to making a serious point.

example.english: Seriously, we need to face this problem.
example.traditional: 講真，我哋要面對呢個問題。
example.jyutping: gong2 zan1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 min6 deoi3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
